title: Google\Cloud\Datastore\V1\EntityResult
name: EntityResult
description: The result of fetching an entity from Datastore.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.version
params.description: The version of the entity, a strictly positive number that monotonically increases with changes to the entity. This field is set for [FULL][google.datastore.v1.EntityResult.ResultType.FULL] entity results. For [missing][google.datastore.v1.LookupResponse.missing] entities in LookupResponse, this is the version of the snapshot that was used to look up the entity, and it is always set except for eventually consistent reads.

params.name: data.cursor
params.description: A cursor that points to the position after the result entity. Set only when the EntityResult is part of a QueryResultBatch message.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: The version of the entity, a strictly positive number that monotonically increases with changes to the entity.

methods.description: The version of the entity, a strictly positive number that monotonically increases with changes to the entity.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: A cursor that points to the position after the result entity.

methods.description: A cursor that points to the position after the result entity.
